Chapter 365.
BABY FEED SUPPLIES (CONTROL) REGULATION 1977

ARRANGEMENT OF SECTIONS.
1. Authorization.
BABY FEED SUPPLIES (CONTROL) REGULATION 1977
MADE under the Baby Feed Supplies (Control) Act 1977.
Dated 200.
1. AUTHORIZATION.
(1) An authorization for the supply of a proscribed article shall be in Form 1.
(2) An authorized person shall, at the time of giving an authorization, give to the person
to whom that authorization relates instructions in Form 2.
2. RECORD OF AUTHORIZATIONS.
Pharmacists shall keep a record of the issue of proscribed articles supplied in accordance
with an authorization in Form 3.
